Dave Matthews Band
June 19, 2022 (Father's Day & Juneteenth)
Something in the Water Festival
Independence Avenue - Moon Stage - Washington, D.C.

*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hyperardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front of House, Stage Left Stack, Approx. 225' from Stage, Mics PAS @ 12'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.61 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.1.3 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Notes:

¹ includes prelude

⁴ without Ben Jaffe
⁵ Preservation Hall Jazz Band cover, without Dave, Tim, Buddy, or Stefan; "Shave and a Haircut" interpolation
⁶ snare intro, Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation

This was the third day of the festival, which took place on Independence Avenue between 9th St. SW & 3rd St. SW. The Moon Stage was located in front of the northwest corner of the Federal Aviation Administration building.

The stage had audio visual problems throughout the afternoon's performances, including static from microphones, phasing, and dropped input sources. The DMB FOH crew did a great job with compensating for these issues, but it was a noticeable blemish on the performance. It's most noticeable in "Don't Drink the Water" and "When the World Ends", but gets much better as the show goes on.

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting me set up in the cage and all their help.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers before me who continue to preserve live music.

Compiled on 2022/06/20.
